pv.body:
Your data stays on your device. Thabat has no server, collects nothing, and has no ads or tracking.

What goes online?

  • Sync (optional): a copy in a private Gist on your own GitHub account, with the token you provide.
  • Mosque times from mawaqit.net, ayah audio from everyayah.com, extra tafsir from alquran.cloud when you ask.
  • Recitation downloads from YouTube/SoundCloud through yt-dlp on your computer, when you ask.
  • Dictation uses the browser or phone service.

Phone permissions

  • Notifications and alarms: adhan and reminders.
  • Location: prayer times and qibla.
  • Microphone: voice notes and dictation.
  • Do Not Disturb and fingerprint: only if you turn them on.

The app lock and notes PIN are a privacy screen, not data encryption.

tour.1.b:
Your daily companion for steady time and worship.
A short tour of the main features — skip it and replay it any time from the ! button.
tour.10.b:
Sync PC and phone through GitHub from Settings.
Plus an automatic weekly backup — your data stays safe.
tour.2.b:
Start the timer and pick a category.
Every 15 minutes lays a brick in its color, every row is a full hour — until your day's wall is built.
tour.3.b:
Go past your goal and stars appear — one per 15 minutes.
After 4 extra hours a crescent rises and grows into a full moon.
tour.4.b:
Times for your city or mosque, with a reminder before the adhan.
At the adhan the timer pauses until you tap "Prayed".
tour.5.b:
Daily wird, memorizing and review, and an offline mushaf in several riwayat.
The more you complete, the brighter your wall and calendar glow.
tour.6.b:
Morning, evening and your own adhkar, with the virtue of each.
Focus mode: one dhikr in large text — tap anywhere to count.
tour.7.b:
Every calendar day shows its wall, stars and misbaha — tap ? for the legend.
